title: listing_deactivated
description: A listing's owner deactivated it, hiding it from the directory. Reversible via listing_reactivated. Not yet dispatched by Pro's Outgoing_Webhooks (no listing_deactivated entry in get_event_source_map()) - this describes the flat payload the declared Payload::listing() builder (wb_listora_automation_payload_listing(), the wb_listora_get_listing_cards() card shape) would produce, flattened at the top level with no nested envelope, plus previous_status.

previous_status.description: The status the listing held before deactivation, usually publish.
